title: calligraphic ink · 3D growth as brushstroke
concept: 5gm's 3D differential-growth polyline — but instead of distributing dots along it, sweep a smooth ink-tube with VARIABLE RADIUS modulated by curvature. Tight bends get pressed hard (thick stroke), straight runs read light. Cream paper background, sumi-ink dark mark. Persian nasta'liq energy: flowing line, no straight edges, weight oscillating. The form is a brush-calligraphy column climbing into volume.
